description: Create one deep link (short link) in the workspace of STRAIT_SECRET_KEY. Returns the link with its shortUrl (https://<workspace>.strait.link/<slug>) to share. The link opens the app when installed (App Links / Universal Links), otherwise the store or website, and keeps the destination through an install. For more than a few links use batch_create_links.

androidFallbackUrl.description: Android without the app (website mode): this page instead of longUrl

campaign.description: Campaign name for analytics; defaults to longUrl's utm_campaign

desktopUrl.description: Computers go here instead of longUrl

expiredAction.description: Where taps go after expiry: page (expired page), store (app store), url (expiredUrl)

expiresAt.description: After this the link stops opening its destination. Omit for never.

iosFallbackUrl.description: iPhone without the app: this page instead of longUrl

longUrl.description: Where the link goes: an https URL on your app's domain. The app receives its path and query as the in-app route.

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

name: create_link
title: Create a link
